title: Page 39
transc:
10 PM
Washn Sept 6th 1862 
For Baden Applause directs me to
say to you that you have
full Powers for every emergency and
must exercise it for the maintainance
of order in the city He
will inform you of Military movements
signed J. J. Jones feel better 


Washington Sept 7. 62
For Babel what about Harpers Ferry
Do you know anything about it
How certain is your information about
Bragg being in the valley of
the Shenandoah signed Adam means President


Wash Sept 7. 62
For Genl Wright Do you
know to any certainty where
Genl Bragg is May he
not be in Century Adam.
